references.text: Refers to the same event where, after seeing the miracle of the loaves, the people tried to make Jesus king and fled.
Continues the account of the crowd that followed Jesus and sought him because of the bread they had eaten.
Describes the arrival of the crowd in Capernaum and Jesus' comment that they were seeking him not because of signs, but because they ate the loaves.
Mentions the same action where Jesus gave thanks (eukharistēsas) before distributing the loaves, as referred to in verse 23.
